title: Lantern Spirit of Paws
description: A surreal humanoid figure with a glowing ornate lantern for a head stands against a dark night sky filled with aurora borealis. The body is covered in large, cosmic paw prints with galaxies inside, while the figure holds a smaller lantern emitting bubbles with paw prints; the lower body dissolves into a flowing, dark blue watery form surrounded by ruined structures and hanging lanterns.
prompt: A surreal fantasy figure whose head is replaced by a glowing ornate Victorian lantern with colorful glass, its translucent body covered in large glowing paw prints containing galaxies and nebulae, holding up a smaller lantern that releases bubbles with paw prints inside, the lower body melting into a dark flowing wave with aurora lights, set against a night sky with purple and green northern lights, ruined gothic structures and hanging lanterns in the background, dark drips and sparkles, mystical atmosphere
